weekly.narrative: Day-1 baseline. Intima Health v5.2.1 is a fast, no-login, warm product with unusually deep content (IVF mode, labs, partner sharing). The main risks are trust (privacy copy that is not true), reliability (identity forks lose data), and an AI that can be unsafe in India-specific red-flag moments. For doctor-referred users the app delivers value in 5 minutes but gives no reason to return by day 30 unless export/summary and reminders are added.
